about: The input data behind the saved evidence, copied byte for byte. `python -m scripts.setup` restores these files; `--refetch` fetches fresh data from the network instead.
attribution: Data from the NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL), https://psl.noaa.gov/

files.transformation: Modified: daily values aggregated to monthly. temp_c, tmax_c and tmin_c are the monthly mean of the daily temperature_2m_mean, _max and _min; rainfall_mm is the monthly sum of the daily precipitation_sum; soil_moisture is the monthly mean of the hourly soil_moisture_0_to_7cm.
